note: The two sets are nearly identical, sharing 18 claims; the only difference is that Set A splits the ceiling dimension into two claims while Set B keeps one. Set A's second ceiling claim invents a datum ('height above ground plane') not stated anywhere on the page and duplicates the first, so it adds a wrong claim rather than information. Both sets share the same fabricated 'cable/hose | material | PVC' claim (the note only refers to sheet XE-001 for cable/hose carrier details) and the same garbled quote 'MUM 1/4 IN/FT', so those errors cancel.
remarks: Both sets bind 11 31 23.A1 (CLOTHES WASHER) and 22 41 23.B3 (PRE-FABRICATED SHOWER STALL) to 'plumbing system | specification reference', contradicting their own keynote claims in the same sets. Both also fabricate 'TO BE PVC CABLE/HOSE' by splicing note 2 ('ALL SUPPLY AND WASTE PIPE TO BE PVC PIPING') with note 3 ('REFER TO SHEET XE-001 FOR CABLE/HOSE CARRIER DETAILS'); the quote does not exist on the page. The quote 'MUM 1/4 IN/FT' is a misread of 'MINIMUM 1/4 IN/FT' and duplicates the waste-pipe slope claim. Several bare-number claims ('component | identifier | 23 56 01', etc.) are trivial fragments of the reference keynote list. Both sets miss the named equipment in the keynotes (HTP SUPERSTOR SOLAR WATER TANK 22 33 00, SOLAR PUMP STATION 23 56 01, BOOSTER PUMP 22 11 23, DISHWASHER 11 31 13.A7) and the FINISH FLOOR 2'-0 3/8" dimension.
